about: A __tests__/ test whose production imports all sit where vitest collects no test (desktop/web/vite.config.ts's exclude: an e2e/ subdirectory other than e2e/platform/, or e2e-release/) is no site, since beside its module it would never run (canopi-f47t.52.228 seam 11); a test of one e2e/platform/ module is a site, because vitest runs the tests beside those modules (canopi-f47t.52.228.35), and so is a test of one src/ module
